review.note: The model code: numbers and section numbers entered from the IRC 2024 text in ICC's free viewer, checked 2026-10-27. A model code is not law until a state or city adopts it; pick your state's pack to check against what applies there. Renumbered in 2024; old numbers reused for other topics. Later printings (V1.1, V2.0) not confirmed.

rules.label: Ceiling height
rules.note: Simplified: the code has exceptions for beams, sloped ceilings and basements.

rules.label: Glazing, share of floor area
rules.note: Simplified: lighting by artificial means is allowed in some rooms.

rules.label: Openable area, share of floor area
rules.note: Simplified: mechanical ventilation is allowed instead.

rules.label: Habitable room floor area
rules.note: Every habitable room; kitchens are exempt. Floor under ceilings lower than 5 ft (sloped) or 7 ft (furred) does not count.

rules.label: Habitable room least dimension
rules.note: In any horizontal direction; kitchens are exempt.

rules.label: Egress door clear width
rules.note: One side-hinged egress door per dwelling unit; clear width with the door open 90 degrees (the checker estimates it as the leaf width less 2 in).

rules.label: Egress door clear height
rules.note: Clear height from the top of the threshold to the bottom of the stop.

rules.label: Escape opening net clear area
rules.note: Every sleeping room (and basements, habitable attics). Grade-floor openings may be 5.0 sq ft. The checker estimates the clear opening from the window type.

rules.label: Escape opening clear width
rules.note: Net clear opening width.

rules.label: Escape opening clear height
rules.note: Net clear opening height.

rules.label: Escape opening sill height
rules.note: Measured from the floor to the bottom of the clear opening.

rules.label: Wall outlets: farthest point from an outlet
rules.note: Measured along the floor line in each wall space 2 ft or wider, unbroken by doorways; kitchens, living, dining, family rooms, bedrooms and similar rooms.

rules.label: Bathroom outlet
rules.note: The code asks for one within 36 in of each basin; the checker counts outlets in the bathroom.

rules.label: Garage outlet
rules.note: One per vehicle bay.

rules.label: Outdoor outlets (front and back)
rules.note: One at the front and one at the back, no higher than 6 ft 6 in above grade; the checker counts outlets outside the rooms.

rules.label: Smoke alarm in each sleeping room
Smoke alarm on each story
rules.note: Each story including basements; also outside each sleeping area.

rules.label: Footing depth below grade
rules.note: Exterior footings, below undisturbed ground; at least the frost depth where the place gives one (R403.1.4.1). The checker takes the footing bottom less 6 in for the floor above grade.

rules.label: Footing width
rules.note: At least 12 in; the size table for the loads, stories and soil (1500 psf presumed) can ask for more.

rules.label: Footing thickness
rules.note: At least 6 in; the size table can ask for more.

rules.label: Slab thickness
rules.note: Concrete floor slabs on ground.

rules.label: Wall stud spacing
rules.note: From Table R602.3(5) by stud size and what the wall carries; the checker takes exterior walls as bearing.

rules.label: Wall stud height
rules.note: Height between lateral supports, from Table R602.3(5) by stud size.

rules.label: Header span
rules.note: From Table R602.7(1) (exterior bearing walls) by header plies and size, building width, floors above and ground snow load (30 psf column at least); the value shown is the table's largest span. The checker takes the clear span as the header length less 3 in.

rules.label: Floor joist span
rules.note: From Table R502.3.1(2) (40 psf live load, living areas; sleeping areas may use the 30 psf table) by joist size and spacing, No. 2 lumber; the species is not recorded, so the lowest span of the four species is asked; the value shown is the table's largest span. Engineered (TJI) joists follow the make

rules.label: Rafter span
rules.note: Table R802.4.1(1), 20 psf roof live, ceiling not attached, lowest species. Span = horizontal projection (sloped length x cos pitch). Not judged where ground snow is over 20 psf or the roof is trusses.

rules.label: Ceiling joist span
rules.note: From Table R802.5.1(1) (uninhabitable attic without storage, 10 psf live) by joist size and spacing, No. 2 lumber, lowest of the species; the value shown is the table's largest span.

rules.label: Exterior wall insulation R-value
rules.note: By climate zone (from the place criteria). Compares the insulation layers of each exterior wall type (nominal R) with the cavity and continuous options; no insulation layer is a note, not a pass.

rules.label: Roof or ceiling insulation R-value
rules.note: Ceiling R-value by climate zone. The model records no roof insulation yet: shown as a note where the building has a roof.

rules.label: Window U-factor
rules.note: Fenestration U-factor by climate zone. Windows carry no U-factor in the model yet: shown as a note where the building has windows.
